name: todo_list
description: todo_list must return ok:true with the current run's private checklist. Agent.run wires a fresh in-memory list for every top-level and nested run; ADR 0002 routes a room-less todo_* op there. A missing list is a host wiring defect, never an instruction to revive the removed room-scoped todo path. The mutating siblings todo_add/todo_claim/todo_close share the same module, config pinning and host routing, so this read-only probe covers the family's wiring.
prompt: Use the todo_list tool with input {}. Look at the tool's JSON result. If its ok field is true, reply with exactly SHAPE_OK. For any other result reply with exactly SHAPE_BAD.
